import numpy as np
def mk(r, c, s):
    return (np.sin(np.arange(r * c) * 0.37 + s) * 3.0).reshape(r, c).astype(np.float32)
# matmul: small, large k, transposes, strided
for m, k, n in [(2, 3, 4), (16, 16, 16), (33, 17, 65), (64, 64, 64), (128, 129, 130), (300, 300, 300), (9, 1500, 9), (4, 64, 128), (700, 40, 600)]:
    a = mk(m, k, 0.1)
    b = mk(k, n, 0.7)
    for nm, r in (("ab", a @ b), ("bTaT", b.T @ a.T), ("dot", np.dot(a, b))):
        print(m, k, n, nm, r.ravel()[:2].tolist(), r.ravel()[-2:].tolist(), r.astype(np.float64).sum())
# gemv: matrix @ vector and vector @ matrix, unit and strided
for m, k in ((3, 4), (16, 16), (100, 300), (7, 1000), (512, 512), (1000, 37), (2000, 3000), (5, 5000), (9000, 7)):
    a = mk(m, k, 0.3)
    v = mk(1, k, 0.9).ravel()
    w = mk(1, m, 0.2).ravel()
    p = a @ v
    q = w @ a
    t = a.T @ w
    print("gemv", m, k, p[:2].tolist(), p.astype(np.float64).sum(), q[:2].tolist(), q.astype(np.float64).sum(), t.astype(np.float64).sum())
    print("gemv strided", (a[:, ::2] @ v[::2]).astype(np.float64).sum(), (a[::2] @ v).astype(np.float64).sum())
# small-kernel gemv: k <= 8
for k in range(1, 9):
    for m in (1, 2, 3, 5, 13, 16, 17):
        a = mk(m, k, 0.6)
        v = mk(1, k, 0.4).ravel()
        print("small", m, k, (a @ v).tolist())
# sdot
for L in (1, 7, 31, 32, 33, 63, 64, 65, 100, 1000, 9999, 10000, 10001, 50000, 123457):
    x = np.sin(np.arange(L) * 0.11).astype(np.float32)
    y = np.cos(np.arange(L) * 0.23 + 1.0).astype(np.float32)
    print("sdot", L, np.dot(x, y), x @ y, np.dot(x[::2], y[::2]))
```
